title: give the UI pass a way to capture CLI output, such as a module copy in the temp directory or a render hook, because hand-traced renders can drift from real output

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-121813-4c84, project ork, item S404:

give the UI pass a way to capture CLI output, such as a module copy in the temp directory or a render hook, because hand-traced renders can drift from real output

Evidence: cp of the module into tmp/ui-1 was denied: "This command requires approval, and this session has no approval surface"
